author: IviFetita
body:
Hi guys~
Today, I have a sug for Avicus improvement on the forums. It is something to know how many time you are online on the forums or on Avicus. Like, when a mod is being judged by his online time, make sure to know he/she is online on the forums and in-game, and not only 6 days in-game but never on the forums. 
Add the online time on the forums to the time online info about the player:

Or, add In-game time online and forums time online.
What do you think?
